# Renee Roaming

> A travel blog and adventure resource hub featuring destination guides, outdoor activity tutorials, and travel photography tips for exploring national parks and wilderness areas worldwide.

Renee Roaming is a travel and outdoor adventure resource created by Renee, an Australian travel photographer based in Melbourne. The site combines practical guides for hiking, camping, and road trips with stunning travel photography inspiration and gear recommendations.

## Key Topics

- National Parks
- Hiking Guides
- Travel Photography
- Camping & Backpacking
- Road Trip Planning
- Destination Guides
- Adventure Travel
- Yellowstone
- Grand Teton
- Yosemite
- Travel Inspiration
- Outdoor Safety
- Camera Gear
- Trip Planning
- Leave No Trace

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.reneeroaming.com): Homepage featuring Renee Roaming's travel blog with photography gear and adventure inspiration
- [About](https://www.reneeroaming.com/about): About Renee from Melbourne, Australia and her adventure photography journey

## Destination & Trip Planning Guides

- [Travel Destinations](https://www.reneeroaming.com/travel-destinations): Travel destination guides for USA locations including Alaska and California
- [National Parks](https://www.reneeroaming.com/national-parks): Comprehensive guides to Yellowstone, Yosemite, Acadia, and Zion National Parks
- [Road Trips](https://www.reneeroaming.com/road-trips): Road trip planning guides featuring US National Parks like Yellowstone and Grand Teton
- [11 Best National Parks to Visit in Summer](https://www.reneeroaming.com/best-national-parks-to-visit-in-summer): Guide to 11 best summer national parks including Grand Canyon and Moab

## Hiking & Outdoor Adventure Guides

- [Hiking](https://www.reneeroaming.com/hiking-guides): Hiking guides covering beginner tips, trail guides, and regional hikes near Mount Rainier
- [Beginner Hiking Guide: Essential Tips for New Hikers](https://www.reneeroaming.com/beginners-hiking-guide): Essential beginner hiking guide covering safety, preparation, and finding hiking partners
- [Camping & Backpacking](https://www.reneeroaming.com/camping-backpacking): Camping and backpacking guides with safety tips and Leave No Trace principles
- [Backpacking for Beginners: Must-Know Tips for Wilderness Camping](https://www.reneeroaming.com/backpacking-for-beginners): Beginner backpacking guide with gear essentials and wilderness camping tips
- [Car Camping Essentials List: Ultimate Printable Checklist](https://www.reneeroaming.com/car-camping-essentials-list): Printable car camping checklist with essentials for national parks and forests

## Travel Photography

- [Photography](https://www.reneeroaming.com/photography): Travel photography guides covering camera gear, editing, and photography tips
